overview.match: Maria Ghobadi is a Los Angeles County deputy district attorn
overview.text: Maria Ghobadi is a Los Angeles County deputy district attorney. She began prosecuting in San Joaquin County in 2007, later prosecuting attorney misconduct for the State Bar of California. In 2015 she joined the Los Angeles County district attorney's office, spending seven years in the gang homicide division. She says she has completed 87 jury trials. In 2025 she prosecuted a man accused of killing a boy.
